title: Strict HTTP/1 chunked-frame parser repair
hypothesis: Repairing a realistic parser can require keeping a byte cursor synchronized across valid chunk framing, extensions, trailers, malformed line endings, and a following pipelined message.
why_hard: Rejecting one malformed line is insufficient if valid frames consume too much or too little input. The correct repair must preserve the next message boundary as well as parse the current payload.
